notes: Coverage: every text block, word and ending, punctuation group, inline expression and both displayed formulas was manually compared against both C and H. Agreed readings were inspected too. This coverage statement concerns visual transcription, not mathematical proof.

Workflow: the whole image was displayed once for layout, then half_a once and half_b once in that order. Nineteen local crops were listed before enlargement. A twentieth locus—the exact rubric underline endpoints—was added during assembly from the recorded half observation; the heading had not previously been cropped, and no whole or half image was reopened. Every retained crop was created once and viewed once. No OCR, recognition software, PDF text layer, outside research, another page or another reader return was used.

The source is an entirely handwritten continuation page. The dark-pen writer is left unnamed because the supplied page packet does not independently establish personal identity. The low-left 13 is a lighter archive-pencil layer and is encoded only as the required archive-sheet comment. No author page number, date, title or stated total page count is visible.

The page states condition b) for an injective F and proposes applying derived sections to a kernel involving a resolution. It then says the cone of a morphism of complexes is not functorial in the derived category with respect to the arrow whose cone is wanted. These are statements encountered on the page, not verified theorems in this run.

The following paragraph says that, in the singular particular current case, a functorial choice ought to exist, and asks whether this is evident. The report preserves le cas particulier actuel, capital-height S in ESt-ce, and the unresolved dot-like accent over évident.

The rubric asks Illusie whether the deformation theory mentioned there can be bypassed using the theory, explicitly described as supposedly written, of Gr-champs or the theory of champs de Picard. The source uses the abbreviated spelling déform.tions. The H^3 and Ext^2 second-argument spaces are blank. The visible last words are J'ai, with no completion supplied from outside this page.

The first-display curve after the upper star is left uncertain without introducing an extra invisible opening parenthesis. The middle formula has separately retained old opening, close and tail material. Its F is heavily retraced, but density alone does not establish a distinct cancelled underletter.

The Ext argument visually favours K over X because of the near-upright left limb. The semicolon's lower curved component sweeps left under the argument's right edge; it was not converted into an underline or a subscript point. A separate comma follows.

Five groups of left-edge ink fragments are drawn in TikZ rather than expanded into speculative words. Their status and relation to the main text remain uncertain. They lie on white paper immediately inside the dark scan edge. The detached low point by ESt-ce and high right stroke by the question are also retained with no-textual-character alternatives; those alternatives do not deny the physical spots.

The faint straight footer line and scattered small surface/edge specks were observed but assigned no textual role. No independent diagram or complex drawing, salutation, signature, caret insertion, or additional heading is visible. Underbrace and rubric underline are preserved separately from textual emphasis conventions.

No targeted proof, independent re-proof, computation, formal certificate, or theorem use/recheck was performed. Delimiter counts, index positions and glyph distinctions were visual structure checks only, so math_checks is empty.

Comparison flags record actual reading, state, omission or uncertainty differences, including removal or reordering of doubts. Macro-name conversions alone were not counted. The 35 locus entries and their witness flags are not error rates.
start_utc is the first recorded UTC timestamp, taken after the initial brief and packet reads had begun; no earlier execution timestamp is invented.

Output verification was limited to JSON/schema integrity, crop-file and reference existence, required inventory flags, and basic TeX delimiter/environment balance. No TeX render or further source image view was performed.
